chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Aamir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fazalat ibn Ayoub from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Baseer who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who increases in his prayer, so upon him is the repeating'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one adds an extra part to their prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of *ikhtiyar* (volition) in prayer validity, distinguishing between intentional addition (*ziyadah*) and unintentional error. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores that prayer is invalidated by deliberate deviation from the prescribed form, reflecting the broader theological emphasis on precision (*dabt*) in ritual worship as a manifestation of reverence for Divine command.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one who increases in his Salāt, so upon him is the repeating’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from abu Basir from who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If one increases something in his Salah (prayer) he performs it again.’”
